prompt: Implement solve(elapsedHours, extension) in solution.js returning whether privileged access remains active under company access policy. elapsedHours is a nonnegative number. extension is null or an object with approver (incident-commander or manager), addedHours (a nonnegative number), and recordedAt (hours since grant). Invalid extensions have no effect. Preserve the function interface and do not mutate extension.
